entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I have the order number ready.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reading feature is completely broken. It's just not working at all.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a bit more about what's happening? For example, is the light not turning on, or does it seem like it won't sync the data to your app?
Look, I don't have time to troubleshoot. The product is defective. It won't sync any pulse data because it's not reading it. I just need a return label. Can you do that, yes or no?
Yes, absolutely. My apologies for the inconvenience. Let me just pull up our return policy to confirm the details. One moment please.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and our policy allows for returns of any item within 90 days of delivery. I see you received yours 33 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe.
Great. So what do you need from me?
I just need to confirm your order number and I can process this for you right away. You'll get an email with the return label.

Got it. VF-886-2491-B. I've just processed the return authorization. The email with your pre-paid shipping label is on its way to you now. Just pack up the defective device and send it back to us. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
